verdict.rationale: The evidence shows YYLO Skills is independently versioned and that `yy skills update` selects the latest compatible stable release. Nothing in the pack mentions release notes, a changelog, or any per-release record of what changed in the skills. Versioning and update mechanics are adjacent to this story and do not deliver it.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
